definitions.explanation: A stretch of land with particular characteristics or designated for a specific purpose. Often used with modifying words to describe the type of zone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{地帯|ちたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧{地帯|ちたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Diverse organisms live in tropical zones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧{地帯|ちたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Development of the industrial zone is progressing.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {工業|こうぎょう}{地帯|ちたい} (industrial zone)
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧{地帯|ちたい} (commercial district)
- {穀倉|こくそう}{地帯|ちたい} (breadbasket, grain-growing region)
- ⟦{山岳|さんがく}→山岳：12522_sangaku⟧{地帯|ちたい} (mountainous region)
- {緑地帯|りょくちたい} (green belt)
- {危険|きけん}{地帯|ちたい} (danger zone)
- {非武装|ひぶそう}{地帯|ちたい} (demilitarized zone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: area, region (general); {地帯|ちたい} stresses a stretch of land with a shared character
- ⟦{区域|くいき}→区域：00251_kuiki⟧: a zone with drawn boundaries, often official
